Summary Description: Dr. Joseph P Havlicek is a scholar at the University of Oklahoma whose work spans biomedical imaging, signal processing, and transform theory. He develops data-driven and physics-informed pipelines for multimodal imaging (CT-PET fusion) to derive per-vertebra biomarkers like SUV and Ki, validated with autopsy findings, and explores novel transform-based approaches for efficient video coding, notably the real-valued Hirschman-based H2 transform and end-effect mitigation techniques. His research emphasizes reproducible computational workflows, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and translational impact in imaging and multimedia processing.
